stories.title: Lando Norris Wins Dutch GP — Verstappen Crashes Out in Heartbreaking Finale — Tier 1

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
LANDO NORRIS WINS THE FINAL DUTCH GRAND PRIX IN HISTORY.

Back-to-back wins. Verstappen crashed on lap 1 in front of the orange army.

Zandvoort is gone from the F1 calendar forever.

What a way to close an era. 🏆

#F1 #DutchGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Norris: 11.5 seconds clear of Antonelli.
Verstappen: crashed on lap 1, never in the race.

The final Dutch GP at Zandvoort belonged to McLaren.

Two wins in a row for Lando. 🧡

#F1 #LandoNorris #DutchGP

stories.title: Verstappen's Zandvoort Goodbye — Damp Corner, Heavy Crash, Ending of an Era — Tier 2

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Max Verstappen's final Dutch Grand Prix ended on lap 1.

Damp corner. Lost the rear. Into the wall.

The circuit built for him. The last race he'd ever run there. Gone.

He called it "disappointing." That's an understatement. 💔

#F1 #MaxVerstappen #DutchGP
